en:
— Stay down.
— Don't move! Don't fucking move!

Put your hands in the air!
Put your hands in the air! Put them up!
Down, down! Get on your knees.

— Give me the keys.
— Get on your knees.
Get on your knees!

Hey. Hey! Get over there.
Get the fuck… Get down.

Turn around! Put your hands behind you.
Behind you!
Get down! Stay down!

Get down! Get down!
Down, you stupid son of a…

— Down! Down, now!
— Keys! Keys! Keys!
All of you stay down.

We want to hurt no one. We're here
for the bank's money, not your money.

Your money's insured.
You're not gonna lose a dime.

Think of your families. Don't risk your life.
Don't try and be a hero.

Right now I want you to sit on the floor
and put your hands on your head.

Anybody feels sick, anybody got heart
trouble, go ahead and lean against the wall.

— Give me the key.
— What key?
Get down and stay down!

Sit there. Sit there.
Don't move. Let it bleed.
Get down!
ru: Всем вниз, на пол! Всем вниз!
А ну-ка, все туда! Все на пол!

Мы никого не тронем.
Нам нужны деньги банка, не ваши.

А ваши деньги в нём застрахованы.
Вы не потеряете ни цента.

Подумайте о семьях и не рискуйте
жизнью. Не пытайтесь быть героями.

Всем сесть на пол
и положить руки за голову.

Если кому-то плохо, болит сердце,
можете прислониться к стене.
